proposals.premise: Friday’s note makes today’s choice direct: pick tart Ashmeads or sweet Russets, avoid the muddy north rows, or visit the shop by gravel path.
proposals.opening: Desktop first shows the harvest note beside the straw-basket photo; phone stacks note, hours, and a clear “Shop only—no booking” line before the photo.
proposals.move: The first control is “Reserve picking.” It opens Saturday times through 14:00; the chosen slot and available rows appear in place.
proposals.tradeoff: Fast task completion and familiar booking flow, at the cost of making the hand-marked map secondary.

proposals.premise: Assume visitors have not decided whether to pick and may need route confidence after rain; the gravel shop path makes a map-led choice useful.
proposals.opening: Desktop first pairs the hand-marked map with Saturday 10–15 details; phone shows the map first, followed immediately by open rows and “Shop only—no booking.”
proposals.move: The first control is a two-choice switch: “Pick apples” reveals reservable slots through 14:00 below the map; “Shop only” highlights the gravel route.
proposals.tradeoff: Clarifies safe access and preserves undecided visits, but adds one decision before a picker reaches booking.
